lines.zh: 我走起来，就是一片叶子
lines.en: When I walk, I am a leaf

lines.zh: 身子边缘长着假的叶缘
lines.en: The edges of my body mimic leaf margins
In the jungle nobody sees me

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪，晃得像风
lines.en: I shift step by step, swaying like wind
My legs are as thin as leaf stalks

lines.zh: 我走在真叶子中间，分不清
lines.en: I walk among real leaves and cannot be told apart
Leaf veins run across my back
When wind comes, I sway with it

lines.zh: 我从枝桠这头爬到那头
lines.en: I crawl from one end of the branch to the other
If touched, I act like a leaf
The leaves rustle, and so do I
Deep in the forest the light is dim, just right
I walk around a dead twig

lines.zh: 脚落在叶面上，没有声音
lines.en: My feet on the leaf make no sound
Shift bit by bit, startle nothing

lines.zh: 我停在两片叶的交界处
lines.en: I stop where two leaves meet

lines.zh: 我挂在那儿，和叶子一样
lines.en: I hang there, just like a leaf
Being perfectly still is my specialty

lines.zh: 背上落了一只小虫，它没发现我
lines.en: A small bug landed on me and did not notice
I keep my legs very close
The jungle is this green, I need not hide

lines.zh: 叶子的味道和我的味道一样
lines.en: The scent of leaves and mine are the same
I wait for the wind to rock me

lines.zh: 阳光斑斑点点落在背上
lines.en: Sunlight falls in patches on my back
I look like a chewed leaf corner
My feet do not move, only my breathing slows

lines.zh: 一只鸟在旁边找食，我屏住
lines.en: A bird is foraging nearby, I hold still

lines.zh: 这么多年，我都没被找出来
lines.en: All this time and I have never been found

lines.zh: 你的眼睛和我一般绿，也没看出我
lines.en: Your eyes are as green as mine and still missed me

lines.zh: 我贴着叶子，你确定我在这
lines.en: I am against the leaf, are you sure I am here
Found out, so I shift slowly
Do not use your hand, I will fall
How did you tell

lines.zh: 我的背是绿的，我的腿是绿的
lines.en: My back is green, my legs are green
I am moving a little that way

lines.zh: 你离这么近，我也不敢动了
lines.en: You are this close, and I dare not move either

lines.zh: 我要是假装叶子，你能看出来吗
lines.en: If I pretended to be a leaf, could you tell

lines.zh: 森林里有很多像我这样的
lines.en: There are many like me in this forest
A corner of my disguise is gone
Half a false leaf margin is gone
I curl up, looking even more like a leaf
It hurts, and I must keep pretending
One leg will not lift
I flip to the leaf's underside
A little green sap leaks out
I move slower than I usually do
There is no hiding this
Do not strike a second time

lines.zh: 你拿东西引我，我看不清
lines.en: You try to lure me, I cannot see what it is
Leaves are my food
I reach out an antenna and touch it
What is in your palm is too bright
I am green, and my mouth is small
Not a leaf, I will not eat it
I edge back toward the leaves

lines.zh: 你举得再近，我也装着看不见
lines.en: Hold it closer and I will still pretend not to see

lines.zh: 这味道太浓了，不像林子里的
lines.en: This smells too strong, not like the forest

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我自己看看
lines.en: Put it down and I will look myself

lines.zh: 被撞了一下，我像片叶子落下
lines.en: Bumped once, I fall like a leaf

lines.zh: 我装不下去了，腿动了一下
lines.en: I could not keep the act, my leg moved
You stepped on a leaf, not me

lines.zh: 我贴在你鞋边上被带走了
lines.en: I stuck to your boot and was carried off
Do not push, I am right on the edge
That broke my disguise
I roll to the underside of the leaf

lines.zh: 你的力气对叶子太大了
lines.en: Your strength is too much for a leaf
I back off three steps before stopping
Touch again and I fall

lines.zh: 在这身绿里找同伴很难
lines.en: Finding a mate in all this green is hard

lines.zh: 她得晃得跟我一样的节奏
lines.en: She has to sway at my rhythm
I searched a season and found none

lines.zh: 叶脉的样子是认亲的记号
lines.en: The vein pattern is how kin know each other

lines.zh: 风吹的时候，我们才互相看得见
lines.en: Only when the wind blows do we see each other
No hurry, leaves grow every year

lines.zh: 我慢慢晃，看有没有回应
lines.en: I sway slowly, watching for an answer
The forest is too dense
I will wait on, no hurry at all
If I fail, I keep being a leaf
A leaf has landed nearby
I drag it beneath me

lines.zh: 不是我的那片，颜色不对
lines.en: Not my kind of leaf, the color is wrong
I cannot chew this
I carry it two steps with my front legs
Too heavy, I cannot drag it
I balance it on my back
Look carefully before deciding
I pause and set it down

lines.zh: 这么小的一片，够吃一阵
lines.en: Such a small piece will feed me a while
I sense something approaching
I flatten instantly against the leaf

lines.zh: 先不动，它未必看得见我
lines.en: Do not move, it may not see me
I tuck my legs into the leaf margins
At this distance I am still safe

lines.zh: 影子压到叶面上，我把腿收拢。
lines.en: A shadow falls across the leaf; I draw my legs in.

lines.zh: 一到近处，我的伪装就不够了
lines.en: Up close, my disguise will not be enough
I shift half an inch outward
You walked right under me
I can let go at any moment
I did not dare breathe, in case it was heard
It stopped, so I must move even less
It has not left the area
If I move, the leaf moves with me

lines.zh: 我保持这个姿势很久了
lines.en: I have held this pose a long time

lines.zh: 翅膀藏在鞘里，随时能飞
lines.en: My wings stay folded, ready to fly
Its shadow moved away
Wait a little and it will leave
I back down along the vein
The underside of the leaf is darker
I am patient in this kind of waiting
It circled and came back
My legs are starting to ache

lines.zh: 只要不动，就还在叶子里
lines.en: As long as I stay still, I am still a leaf
My leg lashed out once

lines.zh: 这个力气，跟叶子拍脸一样
lines.en: This force, like a leaf slapping a face
I bit down on an edge
I bumped it and fell over myself
I lunged and was knocked back

lines.zh: 这么小的爪子，抓不住什么
lines.en: Claws this small grip nothing
I push with all my strength
There is a green streak on your hand

lines.zh: 这一下是本能，不是本事
lines.en: That was instinct, not skill
After striking I immediately play leaf
The jungle has one more leaf
I step out of the leaves

lines.zh: 绿得很标准，就是有点太整齐
lines.en: Green and correct, but a touch too neat
I land on the branch and sway
The wind brought me down
This grove hides me well
I unfold my legs slowly
No sound, only leaves
I stand between two leaves

lines.zh: 阳光下一步，荫凉下一步
lines.en: One step in the sun, one in the shade

lines.zh: 热一来，我的伪装就卷边了
lines.en: The heat came and my disguise curled at the edges

lines.zh: 我从枝头掉下去，像真叶子
lines.en: I fell from the branch like a real leaf
The water soaked me soft
The blast tore my false leaf margins

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过叶丛，扎到了我
lines.en: An arrow came through the leaves and hit me

lines.zh: 一股凉意从叶缝钻进身体
lines.en: A chill came in through a leaf seam into my body
The leaves on the tree are all eaten

lines.zh: 雷照亮了整片林，我被晃得僵住
lines.en: Lightning lit the woods and froze me stiff

lines.zh: 这里没有叶子，我无处可挂
lines.en: No leaves here, nowhere to hang
